style: A single wide full-bleed 16:9 Chinese ink-and-watercolor storybook illustration for a seven year old, rich paper texture, traditional Chinese settings, warm gold and jade, expressive gentle faces, central subjects, no lettering or panels. Wukong when not disguised wears red scarf, gold circlet and ochre tunic.

scenes.title: 一、無底洞府深千尺，白毛妖鼠弄妖風
scenes.scene: Wukong demands an antidote outside the rocky mountaintop cave while a fully clothed lavender-robed mouse sorceress holds closed paired fantasy swords defensively; Tang and companions remain safely behind.

scenes.title: 二、大聖化作小金蠅，深入洞穴探虛實
scenes.scene: A lavender-robed mouse sorceress vanishes down a broad round stone cave opening in a swirl of mist; the three startled disciples hurry toward it with Tang and the white horse only as soft silhouettes in her trail.

scenes.title: 三、供奉牌位露真身，李天王乃義父尊
scenes.scene: Wukong discovers an incense burner and two dark wooden ancestral tablets on a hidden cave altar, their surfaces blank. He takes a closer look, alone.

scenes.title: 四、行者怒上南天門，披香殿前告玉帝
scenes.scene: Sun Wukong kneels and presents two wooden tablets as evidence before the Jade Emperor sitting high on a gold throne in a cloud palace. No readable markings.

scenes.title: 五、哪吒持劍阻天王，天降恩怨訴根由
scenes.scene: Heavenly messenger Taibai in white comes to the gold-armored pagoda-bearing guardian Li Jing and young Nezha at their cloud palace. Li Jing is surprised at the message.

scenes.title: 六、天兵天將下凡塵，圍捕陷空捉妖精
scenes.scene: Taibai presents two wooden tablets to Li Jing while Nezha explains. In a soft distant memory vignette a tiny white mouse sniffs an oil lamp in a Buddhist hall. No typography.

scenes.title: 七、救出唐僧脫魔掌，師徒重上西行路
scenes.scene: Li Jing apologizes to Wukong with a bow outside the round cave entrance, holding a small pagoda. Nezha with red ribbons and orderly celestial guards await behind.

scenes.title: 一、西行路上逢城郭，玉華州界民風淳
scenes.scene: At the round cave mouth Nezha in red ribbons holds a gold ring upright as the lavender-robed mouse sorceress bows contritely, with celestial guards waiting well behind. No injury.

scenes.title: 二、師徒四人換官文，街市繁華引好奇
scenes.scene: Four pilgrims and white horse leave Xian Kong Mountain along a westward path while Li Jing and Nezha ascend toward the clouds far behind, peaceful morning.

scenes.title: 三、王府內院見賢王，言語慇懃接遠僧
scenes.scene: Wukong parts green roadside shrubs and discovers two adult monks in gray traveling robes hiding beside the path, while kindly Tang monk on white horse asks what happened.

scenes.title: 四、三位王子習武藝，初見神僧疑非凡
scenes.scene: Two adult travelers in gray monk robes explain the danger of Yuhua to Tang and his disciples along a sheltered track, ancient walled town on the horizon. No violence.

scenes.title: 五、悟空顯弄千斤棒，八戒沙僧展神通
scenes.scene: Inside a lively roadside inn, a comical swirl of magic wind lifts plain travelers' garments from wooden stands while their owners reach for them. Wukong makes a tiny puff of wind from the doorway.

scenes.title: 六、王爺驚喜拜高徒，懇請神仙傳絕藝
scenes.scene: The four pilgrims enter Yuhua's busy market gate dressed as merchants in humble cloth caps and ordinary robes, with one white horse, no religious garments showing.

scenes.title: 七、夜宿王府待授法，滿城傳頌美名揚
scenes.scene: Plainly dressed pilgrims pose at a humble inn as horse merchants; clever Wukong in plain cap interrupts the conversation while the innkeeper peers at their white horse in the courtyard.

scenes.title: 一、清晨演武場上聚，王子誠心跪拜師
scenes.scene: Midnight above Yuhua, Wukong sends dozens of tiny red-scarfed monkey doubles from his cloud toward palace rooftops, magic sparkles, no sharp objects or bodies being touched.

scenes.title: 二、悟空傳授棒法奇，八戒教習釘耙功
scenes.scene: In a bright palace bedchamber, the surprised newly bald king and queen look in a round bronze mirror as attendants offer warm caps and scarves, comic and gentle.

scenes.title: 三、沙僧降妖寶杖舞，三套神功傳後人
scenes.scene: Tang monk now in red patchwork kasaya and gold monk crown crosses the bright palace threshold with scripture staff and purple bowl. Courtiers wait respectfully in rows.

scenes.title: 四、兵器沉重難揮動，召集神匠仿神兵
scenes.scene: Seated Tang monk in red patchwork kasaya addresses a curious Yuhua ruler inside a sunny royal hall. They discuss the long journey, attendants stand in background.

scenes.title: 五、爐火熊熊映夜空，精鋼巧鑄金箍棒
scenes.scene: Monkey Wukong, pig Baiie and bearded Sha arrive together at Yuhua throne hall, surprising the crowned king and his courtiers. Tang monk already seated beside the king.

scenes.title: 六、九齒釘耙出紅爐，降妖寶杖閃寒光
scenes.scene: Pig Bajie in blue proudly displays his golden nine-toothed rake as an astonished young adult prince holds a smaller training rake. Clear view of two different rakes, no fighting.

scenes.title: 七、神兵夜宿安霞閣，彩光沖天惹妖魔
scenes.scene: In central courtyard, bearded Sha easily catches a young adult prince's ornate practice staff while upright Monkey King's red pole stands nearby. Other princes and teachers watch with delighted surprise.

scenes.title: 一、夜深人靜神光現，黃獅老怪起貪心
scenes.scene: Three young adult princes in yellow, blue and green robes bow to Sun Wukong, pig Bajie and bearded Sha respectively as their martial mentors in the Yuhua hall.

scenes.title: 二、虎口洞中藏神刃，失了兵器三徒急
scenes.scene: The six figures, three pilgrims and their three young adult prince pupils, sit in a single meditation circle, training with palms on the shoulder blades of the person in front. Peaceful gold light.

scenes.title: 三、大聖跳上九霄望，查明妖巢豹頭山
scenes.scene: Three young adult princes practice wide, simple forms with safe wooden staff and rake-like practice props under guidance of Monkey King, pig Bajie and bearded Sha in a royal courtyard. No contact.

scenes.title: 四、巧遇巡山採辦妖，定身奪下買肉銀
scenes.scene: At midnight a golden-maned lion spirit looks down from a cloud and spots three radiant fairy-tale implements in a palace workshop below: one staff, one nine-tooth rake, one ornate monk staff.

scenes.title: 五、悟空八戒扮小怪，大模大樣進洞天
scenes.scene: The monkey, pig, bearded disciple and three downcast young princes discover an empty three-slot display rack in a palace forge. Sleeping embers and a surprised smith standing aside.

scenes.title: 六、筵席籌備釘耙宴，妖魔得意誇寶光
scenes.scene: Wukong on a pale cloud scouts rocky Leopard Head Mountain and spots two small wolf-faced scouts walking far below. No other travelers.

scenes.title: 七、大聖奪回金箍棒，棒打黃獅大破洞
scenes.scene: Two woolly wolf-headed attendants stand on a mountain path with small silver ingots and a shopping basket, chatting about their feast. Wukong listens discreetly behind a pine trunk.

scenes.title: 一、黃獅戰敗奔深山，哭投老祖求援兵
scenes.scene: Two wolf-headed scouts, disguised Wukong and Bajie, and a plainly dressed animal trader, disguised Sha, guide sheep and pigs along a rocky trail toward a distant cave. No normal pilgrim outfits.

scenes.title: 二、九頭獅王抖神威，竹節山中聚群妖
scenes.scene: One wolf-headed scout looks at an open invitation scroll while the other and their trader companion wait with their sheep and pigs. Scroll blank, sunlit rocky mountains.

scenes.title: 三、大聖掄棒迎強敵，妖風滾滾地翻天
scenes.scene: In a warmly lit limestone chamber the golden-maned lion host in ochre robe receives two disguised wolf-faced scouts and a human-looking livestock trader; they gesture as they explain their purchases. No other travelers.

scenes.title: 四、九口齊張吞日月，師徒遇險落魔坑
scenes.scene: Three treasures on a single rack in a lion cavern: nine-toothed golden rake in middle, red-and-gold staff on left, ornate monk's staff on right. Three disguised visitors watch the treasures glow. No weapons in use.

scenes.title: 五、悟空拔毛巧脫身，凌空翻騰探敵情
scenes.scene: The monkey hero, pig Bajie and bearded Sha regain their three iconic implements beside the rack in the cave. Golden-maned lion king steps back startled. No contact, injuries or dead animals.

scenes.title: 六、王府驚聞長老陷，城樓緊閉備戰端
scenes.scene: A golden-maned young lion spirit bows respectfully at the entrance to a deep bamboo mountain grotto, seeking the audience of an elder lion spirit wearing purple robes. Gentle blue lanterns.

scenes.title: 七、行者遙望九華境，急向天宮搬救兵
scenes.scene: Golden-maned young lion asks an elderly regal lion spirit in purple for help in a blue stone cavern. The elder's single lion head, in the guise of a wise speaking elder, listens gravely.

scenes.title: 一、七獅嘯聚攻城闕，旌旗漫捲殺聲震
scenes.scene: Seven distinct clothed lion spirits with different colored manes gather among snowy slopes and bamboo under a regal elder with just one lion head visible in his humanlike guise. Mythical parade, no violence.

scenes.title: 二、大聖揮棒立陣前，八戒沙僧齊出戰
scenes.scene: Regal elderly lion spirit in purple comforts his golden-maned grandson with a paw on his head while other lion spirits prepare on a bamboo hillside. They are not at the city yet.

scenes.title: 三、神棒翻飛如飛龍，打退雪獅退狻猊
scenes.scene: Three pilgrims stand on Yuhua's tiled gatehouse roof looking down at an approaching line of seven clothed lion spirits and colorful flags. Broad view, no contact or injuries.

scenes.title: 四、八戒奮勇揮釘耙，亂戰叢中顯身手
scenes.scene: Outside Yuhua, red-scarfed Monkey King, blue-robed pig Bajie and bearded Sha hold their fairy-tale staff and rake defensively in a broad dust swirl as lion spirits face them across open space. No contact.

scenes.title: 五、生擒黃獅除惡首，群妖潰散走荒丘
scenes.scene: Cloud of harmless dust and a startled blue-clothed pig Bajie losing his balance as a white-maned lion opponent raises an arm in surprise. City walls behind, no cuts or blood.

scenes.title: 六、城頭軍民同歡呼，凱旋回府慶安康
scenes.scene: On a dusty field a swirling crowd of little monkey doubles surround two startled lion spirits, one snowy white and one tawny. No bodily contact, armor intact, other lion figures retreat in distance.

scenes.title: 七、老祖未除患未息，大聖尋源探仙蹤
scenes.scene: An enormous golden magical guardian lion with ONE body and exactly NINE small lion heads blooms from a cloud outside Yuhua gate, as tiny guards step back behind the safe stone parapet. No one in any mouth.

scenes.title: 一、大聖駕雲上天界，尋訪妙嚴東極宮
scenes.scene: Inside a palace with an empty throne, a worried queen asks Sun Wukong with red scarf and bearded Sha for help, and he reassuringly raises an open palm. No Tang monk present.

scenes.title: 二、救苦天尊開金口，道破九頭獅本源
scenes.scene: A gigantic magical nine-headed lion emerges in a bamboo grove, surrounded by golden mist, as Wukong and bearded Sha step back and prepare to retreat. No one in mouths, no injuries.

scenes.title: 三、貪杯獅奴沉醉睡，神獸私自下凡塵
scenes.scene: On a rocky bamboo ridge under a starry sky, lone Sun Wukong sits thoughtfully with staff at his side, looking over the moonlit cave far below.

scenes.title: 四、天尊親駕祥雲降，竹節山前喚神獅
scenes.scene: Wukong arrives at the East Gate of Heaven on a white cloud, greeting a dignified guardian in green armor near bright jade pillars; both with open respectful hands.

scenes.title: 五、老祖聞聲現原形，俯首帖耳不敢狂
scenes.scene: In a cloud palace Taiyi, a kindly ancient Taoist celestial lord in blue-white robes, listens to Wukong while a drowsy lion keeper stands sheepishly to the side.

scenes.title: 六、解救唐僧除殘妖，城中百姓設齋筵
scenes.scene: Taiyi descends gently on a pearl cloud over green bamboo mountain, with Monkey King and a young adult lion keeper nearby. Below a magical nine-headed lion bows its heads obediently.

scenes.title: 七、辭別賢王續前路，一路歡歌向西天
scenes.scene: Yuhua's royal family and three travelers greet reunited Tang monk in the palace garden. Pig Bajie, red-scarfed Wukong and bearded Sha present. Princes show their practice props, welcoming warmth.

scenes.title: 一、金平府裡元宵夜，滿城花燈勝繁星
scenes.scene: Four pilgrims and white horse arrive at a stone bridge beneath the Jinping city gate, where an eager young adult monk in gray stops to greet them. Late afternoon, peaceful.

scenes.title: 二、慈雲寺內瞻佛像，師徒踏月賞金燈
scenes.scene: Elder gray-robed abbot welcomes Tang and the three disciples in a monastery hall beside a softly lit gold Buddha statue and invites them to remain for the festival.

scenes.title: 三、三口金缸盛酥油，百姓虔誠敬神明
scenes.scene: Lantern festival at night: the four travelers stroll among glowing red and gold lanterns shaped like rabbits, deer, whales and horses. A gray-robed abbot shows the way. No signs or words.

scenes.title: 四、妖風呼嘯香雲滾，假扮佛祖下凡來
scenes.scene: Three big golden oil lamps sit in a row beside an ancient arched bridge at night. An elder abbot explains the fragrant oil to Tang, Wukong and companions. A lantern-lit crowd watches.

scenes.title: 五、唐僧合掌急跪拜，妖風席捲掠聖僧
scenes.scene: A startled Tang monk with joined hands finds his opaque red robe fluttering as an otherworldly spiral of lavender fog drifts around the bridge and lifts him into a cloud. Other pilgrims reach safely from a distance, no injury.

scenes.title: 六、大聖騰空追妖影，黑風深處杳無蹤
scenes.scene: Sun Wukong in red scarf follows the dark cloud into a pine ridge, then speaks to a gray-bearded earth spirit pointing toward blue-green Qinglong Mountain. Atmospheric dusk, only two figures.

scenes.title: 七、急返寺中問虛實，方知盤踞青龍山
scenes.scene: Stone doors at the cliff entrance of Xuanying Cave on Qinglong Mountain, with Sun Wukong stealthily peeking inward from one side. Reddish light within; no readable inscription or other pilgrims.

scenes.title: 一、玄英洞外敲金石，大聖怒討假佛魔
scenes.scene: Inside a blue-stone cavern a fully clothed Tang monk calmly addresses three armored rhinoceros kings sitting in a row, each with a distinct horn and textile colors. No ropes, no injuries.

scenes.title: 二、三尊犀怪各披掛，鉞斧藤牌戰行者
scenes.scene: Three clothed rhinoceros kings in distinct gold, ice blue and jade armors step out of cliff cave in an orderly row with decorative fantasy props and distant pennants. Lone Wukong faces them with red staff held lowered.

scenes.title: 三、棒影重重分天地，角鋒凌厲劃狂風
scenes.scene: Sun Wukong holds his iconic red staff horizontally to keep distance from three tall armored rhino spirits in gold, ice blue and jade. Spiraling dust and motion accents only, everyone intact.

scenes.title: 四、八戒沙僧齊助戰，翻江攪海鬥妖神
scenes.scene: Wukong on a small cloud departs the rocky cliff clearing with his red staff as three rhinos step back. In the distance lanterns shine from a town, no injuries, no other pilgrims.

scenes.title: 五、魔頭晃動聚妖令，漫山遍野出狂牛
scenes.scene: Three pilgrims, red-scarfed Wukong, blue-robed pig Bajie and moss-green bearded Sha, arrive together on clouds in front of Qinglong Mountain's rocky double doors, magical staff and rake held upright.

scenes.title: 六、野牛大陣如鐵壁，八戒陷落被生擒
scenes.scene: A magical puff of golden light creates many tiny monkey doubles around Wukong outside a cave while the three distant rhino kings look surprised. A blue-robed pig companion visible at a safe distance.

scenes.title: 七、大聖化光衝重圍，思量破陣搬救兵
scenes.scene: Wide night view of a mass of dark magical cattle crossing a broad mountain field below moonlight. Tiny red-scarfed monkey doubles scramble out of the path into clouds. No blades or bodies touched, child-friendly suspense.

scenes.title: 一、大聖求援凌霄殿，玉帝降旨點神兵
scenes.scene: Lone Monkey King rides a somersault cloud toward a golden gate in heaven, looking thoughtful with one hand under chin and a red scarf streaming. No other pilgrims.

scenes.title: 二、太白金星明指點，四木禽星剋妖犀
scenes.scene: Wukong listens to a dignified green-armored guardian at a golden celestial gate. Beyond, small kitchen attendants carry steaming lidded dishes toward a cloud palace side door. Soft daylight.

scenes.title: 三、奎木狼與角木蛟，斗木獬同井木犴
scenes.scene: In a celestial Chinese kitchen chef Paoding, in simple gray tunic and linen apron, pours clear broth from a ladle over tiny jade-green cabbage hearts arranged in white porcelain bowls. Curious Wukong peers from the lattice window.

scenes.title: 四、神禽凌空展威武，一聲長嘯落妖魂
scenes.scene: Small celestial attendants carry covered porcelain bowls out in a neat row. Sun Wukong politely greets chef Paoding in a warm, steamy heavenly kitchen fragrant with cabbage broth.

scenes.title: 五、犀牛精魂飛魄散，丟盔棄甲竄山林
scenes.scene: Golden-furred Monkey King sips clear broth from a plain white bowl and widens his eyes in delighted surprise, while chef Paoding in simple gray apron watches with a faint smile. Warm backlight and a little steam.

scenes.title: 六、救得師徒出地穴，瓦罐盛來白菜湯
scenes.scene: At a celestial kitchen table chef Paoding explains his cabbage soup to Wukong, who smiles appreciatively over one white bowl containing a small jade-green cabbage heart. No other pilgrims.

scenes.title: 七、熱湯暖胃知冷暖，患難方見真性情
scenes.scene: Thoughtful Sun Wukong and chef Paoding talk quietly near a rich wooden kitchen chopping block. A simple cooking knife rests flat beside a white bowl and uncut cabbage, hands relaxed, no demonstration or injury.
